description: Permanently deletes one plan from the person's account. It cannot be restored. Call this only for a plan that the person named in words. When they name none, as in "delete my plans", do not call this: call list_projects, show the titles and ask which ones to delete.

project_id.description: The project's ID from list_projects or create_project. Never show it to the person.

name: delete_project
title: Delete plan
